mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% within a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0% over 3 months, or the signal fails to generate negative returns in 70% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which signals an impending economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 in two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which triggers recession fears and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO remains below 100 for two months, or the signal’s Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3.0% annualized over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic momentum, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annualized, or the signal’s Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 3.0% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers expectations of tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS >= 2.0%, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 3.8% and a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 100,000 monthly additions signals labor market weakening, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal fails to achieve a Rank IC > 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in residential construction (HOUST) below 1,300,000 units combined with a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) below 510,000 million dollars signals a collapse in housing and consumption demand, which triggers a negative feedback loop in equity markets and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases where both HOUST < 1300.0 and RSAFS < 510000.0, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.
